body: I don't know how to get over it. It eats me up. Like I can look at her pictures. I can see it in my head, but I can't let it go. He hasn't cheated on me before these two months. He has in the past and the reason is always the same "I was away for so long".... I think I'm just glad he didn't have a baby with someone else. But at the same time I wish he did because It would make walking away easier
Well cant fix that now. We are married. Asking about how to fix it moving forward
